question: What was the callsign of the trainee in flight?
procedureDetails: Callsign for flight will be Qatari {callsign_num}CR.

question: Was the Main Switch turned on correctly?
options: No, trainee first tried to turn on engines instead of main switch
procedureDetails: The Main Switch must be turned on first before starting the engines.

question: When were both engines started?
procedureDetails: First Start Engine 1, wait for N1 to become 20% (will show as a green box), then start the 2nd Engine and wait for it to also reach 20% N1 (green box).

question: When were the Beacon and NAV Lights turned on?
options: Lights turned on when the 1st engine was started
Lights turned on after both engines were started
procedureDetails: Beacon and NAV lights must be turned on immediately prior to starting the first engine to indicate the aircraft is about to move or start engines.

question: What was the ground speed during straight line taxiing?
options: Ground speed was less than or equal to 25 knots
procedureDetails: During straight line taxiing, maintain a ground speed of 25 knots or less to ensure safe aircraft control.

question: What was the ground speed during 90-degree turns?
options: Ground speed was less than 10 knots
Ground speed was 10 knots or more
procedureDetails: When performing a 90-degree turn, ground speed should be reduced to less than 10 knots to prevent excessive side loads on the landing gear and maintain safety.

question: Was stopping at the Hold Short Line required and completed correctly?
options: Yes, Hold Short was required and completed correctly ✅
Yes, Hold Short was required but not completed correctly ⚠️
No, Hold Short was not required during this flight ✅
procedureDetails: When stopping at HSL, ensure entire aircraft starting from nose should be behind the line and not just the front landing gear
